message:
Visible, non-interactive element `<enhanced:img>` with a click event must be accompanied by a keyboard event handler. Consider whether an interactive element such as `<button type="button">` or `<a>` might be more appropriate
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_click_events_have_key_events

`<enhanced:img>` with a click handler must have an ARIA role
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_no_static_element_interactions

`foo` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
